summary.text: Jen McEwen is a Democratic state senator from Duluth, Minnesota, who represents District 8 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Darrick Law.
She is an attorney and chairs the Senate Labor and Industry Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: McEwen was born in Carbondale, Illinois, and lives in Duluth, Minnesota. She earned a B.A. from the University of Maine and a J.D. from Hamline University School of Law, and her career experience includes working as an attorney.
She has served as board president of the Damiano Center.
McEwen won the District 7 Senate seat in 2020 and, after the 2022 election, assumed office representing District 8 on January 3, 2023.

Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are Labor and Industry Policy, which she chairs, Environment and Natural Resources Policy and Legacy Finance, where she is vice chair, Energy and Utilities Finance and Policy, and Transportation Finance and Policy.
